rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises due to an unsafe condition (icy walkway), which is a classic premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on ice on the policyholder's front walkway during last week's ice storm. Medical bills are anticipated and parents are seeking coverage. This is a premises liability claim with pediatric injury requiring prompt adjuster review.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway; broke wrist
